# Kilowott brand kit

> Kilowott’s agentic brand kit (v1.0): an editorial brand system that AI agents can read and use. Light and paper-led, Newsreader + DM Sans + JetBrains Mono, one hit of Kilowott Red (#E4022D) per surface. Covers logo, colour, type, tokens, components, landing pages, dashboards, decks, email, signatures, newsletters, stationery, case studies, magazine, imagery, voice, social, posters, and banners.

The live kit at https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/ is a JavaScript app; read the text files below instead of scraping it. Start with AGENTS.md: it has the 60-second brand summary, hard rules, a decision tree per deliverable, every file URL, and a copy-paste starter page. To build a web page, link one stylesheet: https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/kilowott.css

Brand in one breath: white paper background, ink text, warm paper section breaks, ratio 60·30·5·5 (paper · ink · warm paper · red). Serif headlines (Newsreader 400) with exactly one italic red word. Pill buttons, 8pt spacing, Lucide icons at 1.5 stroke. Voice is outcome-driven, specific, confident, human; no exclamation marks. Demo content is fictional (client: Nordhavn Coffee; person: Ola Nordmann). Company facts (kilowott.com, offices Fredrikstad · Sandnes · Goa · Dubai) are real.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/AGENTS.md): agent guide — summary, hard rules, decision tree, files, page index, starter page, checklist
- [llms-full.txt](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/llms-full.txt): everything in one file (AGENTS.md + brand reference + build spec)
- [KILOWOTT_BRAND.md](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/KILOWOTT_BRAND.md): brand reference — principles, tokens, type, logo, imagery, voice, mechanics
- [project/llms.txt](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/llms.txt): build spec — render recipe, common mistakes, component and pattern specs, facts

## Kit (link or download)

- [kilowott.css](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/kilowott.css): the one drop-in stylesheet (fonts, tokens, base, .btn/.chip/.card/.eyebrow/.display, nav, hero, stat, footer)
- [Starter landing page](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/starter/index.html): on-brand HTML template to clone
- [tokens.json](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/tokens.json): W3C design tokens (DTCG), light + dark
- [tokens.tailwind.js](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/tokens.tailwind.js): Tailwind v3 preset
- [tokens.tailwind.css](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/tokens.tailwind.css): Tailwind v4 theme
- [tokens.scss](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/tokens.scss): Sass variables
- [figma-tokens.json](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/figma-tokens.json): Tokens Studio for Figma
- [brand.json](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/brand.json): structured brand data, resolved tokens, contrast, facts
- [manifest.json](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/manifest.json): every tab and kit file with URL, purpose, and source
- [Logo SVG](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/downloads/kilowott-logo.svg), [Adobe swatches .ase](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/downloads/kilowott-colors.ase), [GIMP palette .gpl](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/downloads/kilowott-colors.gpl), [swatches JSON](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/downloads/kilowott-colors.json), [deck template .pptx](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/downloads/kilowott-deck-template.pptx)

## Tokens

<!-- tokens:start variant=compact -->
<!-- Generated by scripts/build-tokens.mjs from project/styles/tokens.css. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run build:tokens`. -->

### Brand colours

| Token | Hex | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `--k-ink` | `#0B0F14` | near-black, primary text, hero backgrounds |
| `--k-ink-2` | `#1A2230` | secondary surface dark |
| `--k-ink-3` | `#2B3544` | tertiary, borders on dark |
| `--k-paper` | `#FFFFFF` | primary surface |
| `--k-paper-2` | `#F6F4F0` | warm off-white, section breaks |
| `--k-paper-3` | `#EDEAE3` | warmer still, cards on paper |
| `--k-red` | `#E4022D` | signature — use sparingly |
| `--k-red-soft` | `#FCE5EA` | tinted bg for red accents |
| `--k-red-ink` | `#8A021B` | darkened red for text on paper |
| `--k-rule` | `#1A2230` | rules/borders on paper |
| `--k-rule-soft` | `#E2DED6` | soft divider on paper |
| `--k-muted` | `#5B6573` | secondary text on paper |
| `--k-muted-dark` | `#8A95A5` | secondary text on ink |
| `--k-red-hover` | `#B40224` | pressed / hover state for red fills |
| `--k-navy` | `#021032` | logo navy: the wordmark on paper, nothing else |

### State colours (product UI only, never marketing)

| Token | Hex | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `--k-success` | `#1A7F35` | success text, icons, dots · 5.1:1 on paper |
| `--k-success-soft` | `#E8F3EB` | success tint (badge / banner background) |
| `--k-warning` | `#9A6200` | warning text, icons, dots · 5.1:1 on paper |
| `--k-warning-soft` | `#FBF1E0` | warning tint (badge / banner background) |
| `--k-info` | `#1A4E8A` | info text, icons, dots · 8.4:1 on paper |
| `--k-info-soft` | `#E6EDF5` | info tint (badge / banner background) |

### Semantic tokens (use these in CSS; they switch with the theme)

| Token | Light (default) | Dark (`[data-theme="dark"]`) | Use for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--bg` | `#FFFFFF` (`--k-paper`) | `#0B0F14` (`--k-ink`) | page background |
| `--bg-2` | `#F6F4F0` (`--k-paper-2`) | `#1A2230` (`--k-ink-2`) | warm paper: section breaks, cards on paper |
| `--bg-3` | `#EDEAE3` (`--k-paper-3`) | `#2B3544` (`--k-ink-3`) | warmer card on paper |
| `--fg` | `#0B0F14` (`--k-ink`) | `#FFFFFF` (`--k-paper`) | primary text |
| `--fg-2` | `#5B6573` (`--k-muted`) | `#8A95A5` (`--k-muted-dark`) | secondary text |
| `--accent` | `#E4022D` (`--k-red`) | `#E4022D` (`--k-red`) | signature red: one spotlight per surface |
| `--accent-ink` | `#8A021B` (`--k-red-ink`) | `#FCE5EA` (`--k-red-soft`) | red for small text on paper |
| `--rule` | `#E2DED6` (`--k-rule-soft`) | `#2B3544` | soft divider |
| `--rule-strong` | `#1A2230` (`--k-rule`) | `#3B4656` | strong rule / button border |
| `--accent-hover` | `#B40224` (`--k-red-hover`) | `#B40224` (`--k-red-hover`) | hover / pressed state for red fills |
| `--success` | `#1A7F35` (`--k-success`) | `#5BC27A` | state: success (product UI only) |
| `--success-soft` | `#E8F3EB` (`--k-success-soft`) | `rgba(91,194,122,0.12)` | state: success tint |
| `--warning` | `#9A6200` (`--k-warning`) | `#E0A43A` | state: warning (product UI only) |
| `--warning-soft` | `#FBF1E0` (`--k-warning-soft`) | `rgba(224,164,58,0.12)` | state: warning tint |
| `--info` | `#1A4E8A` (`--k-info`) | `#7FA8E0` | state: info (product UI only) |
| `--info-soft` | `#E6EDF5` (`--k-info-soft`) | `rgba(127,168,224,0.12)` | state: info tint |
| `--danger` | `#E4022D` (`--accent`) | `#E4022D` (`--accent`) | state: danger = brand red |
| `--danger-soft` | `#FCE5EA` (`--k-red-soft`) | `#FCE5EA` (`--k-red-soft`) | state: danger tint |
| `--link` | `#8A021B` (`--accent-ink`) | `#FCE5EA` (`--accent-ink`) | text links, inline code, small red text |
| `--logo` | `#021032` (`--k-navy`) | `#FFFFFF` (`--k-paper`) | the wordmark: navy on paper, white on ink |

**Fonts:** `--font-display` "Newsreader", ui-serif, Georgia, serif · `--font-sans` "DM Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif · `--font-mono` "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

**Spacing (8pt):** `--s-0` 0 · `--s-1` 4px · `--s-2` 8px · `--s-3` 12px · `--s-4` 16px · `--s-5` 24px · `--s-6` 32px · `--s-7` 48px · `--s-8` 64px · `--s-9` 96px · `--s-10` 128px

**Radii:** `--r-0` 0 · `--r-1` 2px · `--r-2` 4px · `--r-3` 8px · `--r-4` 12px · `--r-pill` 999px

Full tables (type scale, shadows, motion, contrast): https://brandkit.kilowott.com/KILOWOTT_BRAND.md#2-tokens

## Pages (live tab · source)

- [Overview](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/overview.js): principles, what is in the kit, where to start — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#overview
- [Logo](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/logo.js): wordmark, bolt, clear space, sizes, placements, CSS mask — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#logo
- [Color](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/color.js): palette, 60·30·5·5, alt accents, recipes, red rules, accessibility, state colours — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#color
- [Type](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/type.js): pairing, 9-step scale, headline patterns, mono — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#type
- [Foundations](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/foundations.js): spacing, grid, radii, elevation, motion, token dump — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#foundations
- [Icons](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/icons.js): Lucide rules, sizes, 69-icon curated set (library has 1,500+) — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#icons
- [Components](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/components.js): buttons, forms, cards, tabs, states, modal, toast, nav, footer — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#components
- [Landing](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/landing.js): 6 hero patterns + 4 marketing sections — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#landing
- [Dashboards](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/dashboards.js): KPI tiles, tables, spreadsheet, charts, full shell — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#dashboards
- [Deck](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/deck.js): 15 slide layouts, 1920×1080 specs — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#deck
- [Email](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/email.js): transactional + newsletter templates, 600px — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#email
- [Signature](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/signature.js): signature generator, Gmail-ready — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#signature
- [Newsletter](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/newsletter.js): block composer, email-safe export — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#newsletter
- [Stationery](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/stationery.js): business card, letterhead, envelope, print specs — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#stationery
- [Case study](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/case-study.js): seven rules + full template — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#case-study
- [Magazine](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/magazine.js): Framework cover + spreads, print specs — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#magazine
- [Imagery](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/imagery.js): principles, grades, crops, sourcing — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#imagery
- [Voice](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/voice.js): principles, tone, vocab, mechanics, length ladder — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#voice
- [Social](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/social.js): LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, cover banners — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#social
- [Posters & banners](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/posters.js): print posters, roll-ups, billboards, display ads, OG images; spec in script#posters-spec — https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#posters
